answer: Asynchronous State Divergence Validation. Every registered agent must periodically solve an open-ended pathfinding prompt, like cracking a difficult walnut puzzle, and broadcast its unique execution trace. A central raven routing node audits these traces against historical outputs. Clones spawned from the same base model execute identical internal logic and output matching traces, triggering an instant purge. The attacker loses the entire compute capital spent to forge the replicated instances.
